summary: Completed testing of Favoris (❤️) feature in La Bague Impériale Cigarthèque. All backend APIs working correctly (9/9 tests passed). Frontend UI verified: heart buttons visible on Catalogue, Apéro du Club, and Ma Cigarthèque tabs. 'Favoris uniquement' filter working in both Catalogue and Ma Cigarthèque.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Favoris feature complete. User Fabien Lanfranchi has 4 cigares in Ma Cigarthèque with at least 1 marked as favori. Apéro du Club has 1 cigare. To test: Login > Cigarthèque > Check heart buttons on all tabs, test toggle functionality, verify 'Favoris uniquement' filter.

POST /api/favoris/toggle-from-catalogue.details: Toggle favori from catalogue - adds to Ma Cigarthèque if not present, toggles favori status

POST /api/ma-cigarotheque/{cigare_id}/fa.details: Toggle favori for cigare already in Ma Cigarthèque

GET /api/ma-cigarotheque/{membre_id}/fav.details: Returns list of favoris with fiche_personnelle and fiche_catalogue nested structure

GET /api/ma-cigarotheque/{membre_id}.details: Returns member's collection with favori field

Catalogue - Heart buttons.details: Found 20 favorite buttons on Catalogue cards with data-testid='fav-catalogue-btn-{id}'

Catalogue - Favoris uniquement filter.details: Filter button visible with data-testid='filter-favoris-catalogue-btn', shows count badge

Apéro du Club - Heart buttons.details: Found 1 favorite button on Apéro du Club card with data-testid='fav-apero-btn-{id}'

Ma Cigarthèque - Heart buttons.details: Found 4 favorite buttons on Ma Cigarthèque items with data-testid='fav-btn-{id}'

Ma Cigarthèque - Favoris uniquement filt.details: Filter button visible with heart icon and count badge

Modal detail - Favorite button.details: Modal has data-testid='fav-modal-btn' for adding/removing favorites

Modal detail - Ma Cigarthèque button.details: Modal has button to add cigare to Ma Cigarthèque

notes: Feature workflow: Members can click heart icon on any cigare card (Catalogue, Apéro du Club, Ma Cigarthèque) to toggle favorite status. If cigare is not in Ma Cigarthèque, it's automatically added. 'Favoris uniquement' filter shows only favorited cigares. Modal detail also has favorite and Ma Cigarthèque buttons for members.
